E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Frankie and Darren have a heart-to-heart and Theresa is desperate for answers. Meanwhile, Ant reaches out to Kathleen-Angel and the young couple give things another go...

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Party: Ahead of the summer vacation, Janine throws the perfect end-of-year party for her colleagues and friends. Series finale. (S3 Ep14/14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Brother's Keeper: Will is confident that he'll slam dunk a college basketball scholarship, until he learns the truth about his closest competitor. (S2 Ep15/24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Geoffrey Cleans Up: When Geoffrey discovers that his new love is an heiress, not a housekeeper, he can't ignore the gulf between their social positions and ends their romance. (S2 Ep16/24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics watch The Apprentice, Hunted, Corrie, The Underdog: Josh Must Win, Bridge of Lies, and the News on the Princess of Wales' cancer diagnosis. (S23 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers tune in to Gladiators, Is It Cake?, Casualty, The 1% Club, The Yorkshire Farm, This Morning, BBC News on the cost of living, and more. (S23 Ep8)
